name: 行锁级联: blocker idle in tx
cause: dead_tuple_ratio > 20% — cost delay 可能过高
findings: 死元组堆积严重，autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay 可能设置过高导致回收缓慢
actions: [排查] 查看当前 cost delay 配置 | SQL: SHOW autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay;
[修复] 降低 autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay | SQL: ALTER SYSTEM SET autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay = '2ms'; SELECT pg_reload_conf();

name: 行锁级联: blocker 跑慢SQL
cause: lock_waits > 3 — 可能有 DDL 锁
findings: 可能有 ALTER TABLE / CREATE INDEX 等 DDL 操作持有 AccessExclusiveLock 阻塞查询
actions: [排查] 查看 AccessExclusive 锁持有者 | SQL: SELECT l.pid, a.usename, l.relation::regclass, l.mode, a.state, LEFT(a.query, 80) FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.mode = 'AccessExclusiveLock' AND l.granted
[修复] 使用 CONCURRENTLY 选项避免阻塞 | SQL: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_name ON table_name (column);

name: DDL 阻塞 DML
cause: 存在多个慢查询 — 可能有执行计划跳变
findings: 慢查询突然增多可能是执行计划跳变导致，通常由统计信息过期引起
actions: [排查] 检查表统计信息是否过期 | SQL: SELECT schemaname, relname, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze, n_live_tup, n_mod_since_analyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_mod_since_analyze > n_live_tup * 0.1 ORDER BY n_mod_since_analyze DESC LIMIT 10
[修复] 对统计信息过期的表执行 ANALYZE | SQL: ANALYZE {schema}.{table};

name: VACUUM 与查询锁冲突
cause: dead_tuple_ratio > 10% — 可能存在 TOAST 膨胀
findings: TOAST 表可能存在膨胀，大字段更新频繁时 TOAST 表不会被自动回收
actions: [排查] 查看 TOAST 表大小 | SQL: SELECT c.relname AS main_table, t.relname AS toast_table, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(t.oid)) AS toast_size FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_class t ON c.reltoastrelid = t.oid WHERE pg_relation_size(t.oid) > 100*1024*1024 ORDER BY pg_relation_size(t.oid) DESC LIMIT 10
[修复] 对含大 TOAST 的表执行 VACUUM FULL | SQL: VACUUM FULL {schema}.{table}; -- 会锁表

cause: dead_tuple_ratio > 8% — 阈值可能过高
